title: Patient agreement to improve secondary prevention after acute myocardial infarction
summary:
Patients with an acute type 1 myocardial infarction are informed about target values ​​and guideline-based secondary therapy according to the hospital's standard of care upon discharge. The intervention group receives a patient agreement outlining medication and target values, which is signed by both the patient and the treating physician. The signed agreement is given to the patient to take home. A copy remains in their medical record.

Six months after discharge, the patients are contacted centrally by the Institute for Myocardial Infarction Research Foundation and asked a standardized questionnaire about their knowledge and current values.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
acute myocardial infarction
Written Informed Consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. participation in another randomised trial 
2. forseeable problems to perform 6-month telephon follow-up
3. problems to understand the content of the patient contract
